agents.name: Intake Agent
responsibilities: Ingests email attachments, PDFs/scanned PDFs (OCR), Excel/CSV, Word, and photographic receipts
Outputs strongly typed IntakeExtractedPayload: partner_id, submission_type, parent_pre_approval_id, amount, currency, activity_date, invoice_numbers, supporting_docs_manifest
Attaches physical provenance coordinates: doc_id + page_number + bounding_box and confidence score (0.0 to 1.0)
Performs Southeast Asian thousand/decimal delimiter normalization, eliminating German/Anglo-American digit conflicts
Streams compact 300-500 token JSON downstream, cropping 1-2 page bounding snippets only when visual human check is requested
defenses: Cross-Document Consistency Check: cross-verifies words and digits; resets confidence to 0 when Sum(Line Items) != Total Amount
Confidence Circuit Breaker: amount_confidence < 0.90 immediately flags FLAG_LOW_CONFIDENCE
Budget Block Invariant: amounts without validated confidence score or human confirmation are strictly prohibited from entering Agent 4 budget ledger
No LLM Auto-Completion: unrecognizable fields or schema conflicts return status: FAILED_PARSING with explicit error code

agents.name: Validation Agent
agents.token_profile: Single-round aggregated questions, max 1 clarification interaction (< 400 tokens/event)
responsibilities: Mandatory field completeness check: applicant, partner ID, activity subject, amount, date, line-item invoices
Partner identity verification: validates partner_id status and current Tier (Elite / Gold / Silver / Registered)
Claim-to-PreApproval matching: CLAIM submissions must provide valid parent_pre_approval_id in APPROVED state
Duplicate prevention: invoice deduplication + 90-day same-partner same-activity same-amount collision check
Generates single-round open_questions bound to physical evidence_sources upon detecting gaps, pausing execution for human response
defenses: Zero auto-guessing: conflicting invoice amounts prompt questions rather than choosing sides
Single-Round Batching: scans all discrepancies and asks in one batch, eliminating tedious multi-round back-and-forth
Clarification Record persistence (record_id / answered_by / resolution / timestamp), preventing Agent 3 and Agent 6 from re-prompting
Pipeline freezes at NEEDS_CLARIFICATION while clarification is pending, blocking premature rule evaluation

agents.name: Rules Engine
agents.token_profile: 0 runtime tokens (deterministic rule execution, millisecond latency)
responsibilities: Design time: unifies company glossary, compiles draft rule matrix, runs Grill-With-Docs interrogation, generates test vectors
Runtime: loads active versioned rule package, executes deterministically row-by-row, emits rule_id evaluation status
Enforces hard constraints: R-DATE-001 claim window, R-RATIO-002 co-op ratio, R-CAP-003 tier cap, R-MATCH-004 pre-approval match
Every finding carries error_code, metric, policy_ref, and evidence_refs physical anchors
Solidifies policy ambiguities into ADR records signed off by company policy authorities
defenses: Never uses LLM for runtime policy interpretation; eliminates LLM hallucination or autonomous policy invention
Un-enumerated situations immediately return REQUIRES_POLICY_INTERPRETATION and escalate to human policy owner
Submissions stay permanently bound to rule_version active at submission time; new rules apply only after effective_date
Policy conflicts never silently override; flags affected submissions and highlights conflicting rule codes

agents.name: Budget & Claim Verification
responsibilities: Maintains four-state budget pool: Allocated / Committed / Approved / Paid, deriving Available in real-time
Executes RESERVE_COMMIT to freeze pre-approval limits, and COMMIT_TO_APPROVE for atomic Committed to Approved transfers
Executes RELEASE_COMMIT to unfreeze reduced/rejected amounts, and PAY to record actual disbursement settlements
Enforces invariant Available >= 0; insufficient funds or cap overflows immediately trigger hard budget blocks
Writes immutable budget_transactions log entries with idempotency_key = submissionId:action:runId
defenses: Idempotency verification: retried requests matching existing idempotency_key return ALREADY_PROCESSED with zero double-deductions
Row-level locking: concurrent transactions queue sequentially, reading freshest available balance
Database-level CHECK (allocated_amount >= committed_amount + approved_amount + paid_amount) invariant conservation
Automated reconciliation audits four-state sums against physical transaction logs

agents.name: Exception Agent
agents.token_profile: 99% business exceptions consume 0 tokens; targeted security audit only on trigger
responsibilities: Strictly bifurcates exceptions into Business Track (missing docs, variance, rule conflict) and Security Track (injection, tampered files, unauthorized escalation)
Business Track: structures missing document checklists and factual evidence chains for Agent 6 memo generation
Security Track: executes trust boundary inspection (Untrusted Zone to Intermediate Processing to High-Trust Zone)
Classifies security findings into three states: confirmed / needs_validation / rejected
Emits finding_id, threat_type, trust_boundary_crossed, impact_assessment, and action_taken
defenses: Independent Validator Agent acts as red-team to falsify findings, preventing normal commercial terms from false-positive quarantine
Sandboxed inspection in isolated environment; non-conforming attachments rejected statically without host execution
Data passing from untrusted zone into high-trust zone undergoes sanitization and schema stripping
Only confirmed security hazards route to SECURITY_QUARANTINE; ordinary commercial errors route to business track

agents.name: Human Review & Workflow Agent
agents.token_profile: Strict context < 1,500 tokens (structured findings 400 + policy clauses 200 + templates 150)
responsibilities: Aggregates Agents 1-5 findings into 6-section review memo: Summary, Verifications, Issues & Evidence, Actions, Sign-Off, Citations
Drafts partner Information Request notifications for external documentation follow-up
Calculates reduction alternatives for amounts exceeding pre-approvals for one-click approver selection
Applies Company Mindset principles and Communication Guidelines to adapt tone by audience
Retains 100% final authorization authority in human approver hands with digital audit sign-off
defenses: Issue completeness: every upstream exception has an unambiguous corresponding memo entry
Absolute citation traceability: every recommendation references policy_id and doc_id:page anchored in Policy Wiki
Commitment ban: intercepts unauthorized promises like 'We guarantee payment', enforcing neutral status wording
Draft isolation: all outbound text defaults to DRAFT_PENDING_REVIEW until human sign-off

agents.name: Workflow, Audit & Reporting Agent
agents.token_profile: Live DeepSeek AI briefing generation (< 500 tokens) + event log SQL aggregates
responsibilities: Executes Executive AI Briefing (Boss Skill) providing BLUF summary, financial risk rating, and decision guidance
Logs every workflow transition, rule evaluation, and human action as immutable audit events
Separates observed symptom from root cause, supporting deterministic single-step reprocess on RECOVERABLE_ERROR
Computes real-time case Ageing against SLA thresholds (Pending Partner: 5d / Ops Initial: 48h / Director Approval: 3d)
Outputs Operations, Finance, and Executive decision dashboards with multi-dimensional drill-downs
defenses: Append-only audit store; historical decisions and logs are immutable (Iron Invariant 4)
Engineering discipline: TDD red-green-refactor loop, systematic root cause debugging, sandbox pre-flight checks
Live LLM grounding: DeepSeek briefing synthesizes only verified evidence from pipeline stages
Tracks straight-through processing (STP) rate, AI model latency, and human intervention rates

state_machine.trigger: Missing document classified, handoff to Agent 6 for notification draft
Standard business exception or normal processing
Direct approval by authorized approver after clarification review
Approved by finance/ops after manual amount verification
Agent 7 audit archiving and reconciliation closure
Rejection archived with complete audit trail
Administrator repairs environment and triggers single-step replay
